title: Internal coinduction along a prime-power coefficient quotient
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, $1\leq s\leq r$, $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$ and $\Lambda_s=\mathbf Z/\ell^s\mathbf Z$, a $\Lambda$-algebra through the quotient map. Let $X$ be a scheme and use the derived categories of module sheaves over the constant rings $\Lambda_X$, $\Lambda_{s,X}$ on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], restriction of scalars along $\Lambda_X\to\Lambda_{s,X}$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. For $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ put $K_s=R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(\Lambda_{s,X},K)\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda_s)$. For every $M\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda_s)$ there is an isomorphism $$R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(M,K)\cong R\mathcal Hom_{\Lambda_s}(M,K_s)$$ in $D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$, natural in $M$ and $K$, where $M$ on the left and the right-hand side are viewed as $\Lambda$-complexes by restriction of scalars. It is the internal derived form of the restriction--coinduction adjunction: a local section $\phi:M\to K_s$ is sent to its composite with evaluation at $1\in\Lambda_s$, $K_s\to K$. No potentiality, constructibility or bound beyond $D^+$ is assumed.
